## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `project_id` | `string` | yes | — | Project ID whose workspace to enumerate. Falls back to the active project if omitted. |
| `workspace` | `string` | no | — | Workspace name or ID (default: first workspace) |
| `count` | `integer` | no | `5` | Total number of files to select (default 5). |
| `weights` | `object` | no | — | Optional weighted distribution across categories. Defaults to the codebase-inspector spec: {source: 0.40, specs: 0.20, tests: 0.15, config: 0.10, recent: 0.15}. Values are normalized. |
| `recent_days` | `integer` | no | `7` | Files modified within this many days are eligible for the 'recent' category (default 7). |
| `history_lookback_days` | `integer` | no | `21` | Exclude files that were inspected within this window, based on project-memory inspection records (default 21). Set to 0 to disable. |
| `seed` | `integer` | no | — | Optional RNG seed for deterministic selection (useful for tests and reproducible runs). |
